_doc: Body registry for tools/build_fighters.py (lane ASSETS). fbx is relative to the Mixamo characters folder.
heightM is the DEFAULT normalised rest height (top of hair to sole); data/fighters/<id>.json heightM (lane FIGHTERS) overrides it when present.
hide = regexes of prop meshes removed before export (CONTRACT 5.4). Heights: _research/characters/ROSTER.md target heights where it has one; otherwise a designed value marked 'assumed'.

goon_* bodies (BRAWL BREAK studio goons, CONTRACT 4.3.14 / CHANGED(ASSETS) goons): built with `tools/build_fighters.py --goons` (not part of --all), clip plan = _shared.json + tools/clipplan/_goons.json (+ its _override.<id>), budgetMB = the per-GLB size gate, repaint = texture edits applied by tools/goon_repaint.py before the atlas bake (the printed POLICE / SWAT on Ch35 become the show's K13 SECURITY lettering).

goon_hardhat.note: research ROSTER enemy #3 Hardhat (bruiser): white hard hat, hi-vis vest; 1.95 m per the research table; decimate 0.72: the first bake (53,738 tris) compressed to 1,555,032 B > the 1.5 MB goon budget

goon_security.note: research ROSTER enemy #5 Riot Gas (show security): gas mask + helmet; printed POLICE/SWAT repainted

ch35_1001_diffuse.why: back print SWAT (upside down in UV space)

goon_medic.note: research ROSTER enemy #7 Scrub (show medic): cyan scrubs, cap, mask
